scope: Fixed-Evidence replay pilot; real provider, production Python runtime and isolated PG. No ingestion, dense retrieval, Java auth or browser acceptance.
assessment: Source-based Codex AI review, not blind and not a human gold standard. Runtime model review is not used as semantic scoring.

independent_candidate_review.basis: Codex source-based AI review, not blind or human gold. 04 unsupported-explanation rejection is justified; additional answer wording objection is not independently established. No successful complete semantic repair.

limitations: Same six previously seen development tasks; not held-out.
Fixed public Evidence; no ingestion/retrieval/Java/browser end-to-end evaluation.
Model aliases and remote hardware are not immutable verified identities.
Failed initial attempts are preserved. Candidate not deployed; live Python stays on frozen C.
